cd /app/work && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, random, os, sys, resource
random.seed(4)
# ~40MB single request: 12000 states, 8 ranks x 6 vectors x 12 ints + 60000 edges
P, R, D = 8, 6, 12
inputs = [[[ (r*D+i)*1 for i in range(D)] for _ in range(R)] for r in range(P)]
n = 12000
states = []
for s in range(n):
    rows = []
    for rr in range(P):
        rows.append([[8*(i+1) for i in range(D)] for _ in range(3)])
    states.append({"delivered": rows, "slots": []})
edges = []
seen = set()
for i in range(n):
    edges.append([i, "ring", (i+1) % n])
i = 0
while len(edges) < 60000:
    u = random.randrange(n); v = random.randrange(n)
    a = "ch%02d" % (i % 16); i += 1
    if (u,a,v) in seen: continue
    seen.add((u,a,v)); edges.append([u,a,v])
fair = [{"action": "ch%02d" % j, "mode": ("strong" if j % 2 else "weak")} for j in range(16)]
req = {"op":"audit","inputs":inputs,"states":states,"edges":edges,"start":0,"fairness":fair}
data = json.dumps(req)
print("size MB:", len(data)/1e6)
open('/app/work/huge_audit.json','w').write(data)
PYEOF

import os, sys, resource, time, json, subprocess
data = open('/app/work/huge_audit.json','rb').read() + b"\n"
t0=time.time()
pid = os.fork()
if pid == 0:
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/app/submission/main.py"], input=data,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    sys.stderr.write("rc=%d outlen=%d err=%s\n" % (p.returncode, len(p.stdout), p.stderr[:300]))
    open('/app/work/huge_out.json','wb').write(p.stdout)
    os._exit(0)
os.waitpid(pid, 0)
ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print("peak child RSS: %.1f MB  elapsed %.1fs" % (ru.ru_maxrss/1024.0, time.time()-t0))
r = json.loads(open('/app/work/huge_out.json','rb').read())
